abyss_king.name: The Abyss King
abyss_king.role: Former lord, now tyrant. Certain of his cure; fear appears only at recognition.

ian.name: Ian
ian.role: The previous Bladeborn, present only as a spirit. Warm, grounded, proud without grand speeches.

ak.king.offer.text: Every healer fights death. Every parent begs for more time. I found an answer. You climbed all this way to destroy it.

voice.speaker: abyss_king
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.king.price.text: They will never grow old. Never bury their children. You offer them a few frightened years and call that mercy.

choices.text: Their lives belong to them. Fight me.

voice.speaker: abyss_king
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.king.recognize.text: No. Ian is dead. There has been no Bladeborn since him. You should not be able to stand against this power.

choices.text: And yet I am still here.

voice.speaker: abyss_king
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.king.plunge.text: A part of the Void was not enough. Then I will take the rest. I will not lose Aerth to you.

voice.speaker: abyss_king
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.welcome.text: You fought for them before you knew you could win. I have been waiting to meet the person who would do that.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.name.text: What remains of me. I lived my life, and it was a good one. Yours is only beginning. You are Bladeborn.

choices.text: Then where did this power come from?

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.family.text: Your blood carries an old Bladeborn line. Thomas found you without a family and raised you as his own. The blood was a gift from people you never knew. The courage was yours.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.father.text: Of course he is. The man who stays, feeds you, worries, and lets you go when every part of him wants you safe? That is a father.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.souls.text: The King can command them no longer. But the binding still holds their souls here. We have to break it from within.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.blade.text: Take my blade. Put everything you have into one cut. Not at the people. At the bond that holds them. I kept Aerth safe as long as I could. Now it is your turn.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.restored.text: Look. The souls are going home. Even those whose bodies fell are whole again. They can choose. They can live. You gave them their lives back.

voice.speaker: ian
voice.direction: Clear conversational words. Let the pauses carry the scale; avoid a theatrical growl on every word.
voice.context: King phase one is partly infused. Recognition confirms Bladeborn for the first time. Ian is a spirit, never physically resurrected.

ak.ian.legacy.text: One day, when your life is done. The Bladeborn who came before us are together. We teach, we learn, and we watch over Aerth. But not yet. You have a home to return to.

choices.text: Then I had better get back to it.
